description: Paste text through the actual focused page clipboard/input behavior. This uses a room-private virtual clipboard and never reads the operator OS clipboard. Optional target_id addresses only that already-owned page without selecting, creating or focusing it. Requires the declared native browser transport. The browser door page_editing_profile explicitly chooses Markdown-derived text/html alongside text/plain, or plain text for its declared document profiles; the model does not choose an application or OS clipboard.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
